tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Full-text search over the pracht framework documentation at https://pracht.resynapse.dev. Returns the best-matching page sections, each with its page path, section anchor, URL, and a snippet. Pass a result's `page` and `section` to docs_read for the full text.

tools.name: docs_read
tools.description: Return one page of the pracht documentation as Markdown, or only one section of it. `page` accepts a path (/docs/capabilities), a slug (capabilities, recipes/auth), or a page URL. A whole-page read lists the page's anchors in `sections`. An unknown page or section answers found: false with the close

tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: The table of contents of the pracht documentation: every page with its path, title, URL, and one-line summary, grouped like the site navigation.
